name: f4chan
description: Browse the catalogue of any 4chan board and fetch any available thread. Returns formatted markdown with OP content, reply excerpts, and image links.

params.name: action
params.description: 'catalog' to list threads on a board page, or 'thread' to fetch a specific thread

params.name: page
params.description: Catalog page number (default 1, ignored when action is 'thread')

params.name: offset
params.description: Skip this many replies (thread only, default 0)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max replies to return (thread only, default 50, max 100)
